classification: Decision-input data-rights gate: vendor-licensed CEX references, caller-held quote provenance, and staging-evidence isolation
receiptImpact: Existing OracleSafetyCheck and ExecutionReceipt layouts, registry release, attester keys, partner policies, and activation set v6 remain unchanged. DecisionInputAssessment gains optional signed quote-provenance and evidence-use fields. Customer-facing CEX reference collection, backfill, and eligibility now fail closed unless a reviewed vendor-license agreement reference exists; historical CEX rows are research-quarantined. The SDK rejects signed staging evidence by default unless the verifier explicitly opts in.
activationRule: CEX market-reference rows may be used for customer-facing decisions only when their source is in the reviewed vendor-licensed register and the durable row carries its agreement reference. Callers may explicitly require a hash-only, caller-held quote-provenance envelope that binds source, asset, chain, price, time, and request/response hashes; raw vendor traffic remains with the caller. Synthetic evidence is accepted only for explicit staging exercises and is rejected by customer-mode assessment and default SDK verification. This promotion changes no partner activation, partner reliance, execution authority, or npm publication.
